snippet.title: Counterweight Game Trailer
snippet.description:
A social deduction tower-builder for 3–8 players. Stack blocks, raise the tower, and figure out which of your friends is placing them badly on purpose. Grab chaotic items, vote people out, and forge the Impostor Detector before every block hits the ground.

Wishlist on steam and join the discord. Links in bio
